entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate unique-item modeling turnaround, not runtime art.
Subject: ONE Gonnagal's Dirk, productionId item.design.unique.gonnagal-s-dirk, ICURS_GONNAGALS_DIRK 54. Use the attached PRIVATE ORIGINAL INVENTORY SPRITE only as reference for its exact readable proportions, silhouette and local colors. A short broad straight silver-steel dagger blade with compact pointed tip and central bevel, simple narrow warm-brass U-shaped crossguard with very short ends pointing toward the blade, dark navy-blue tightly wrapped grip, small flat round brass pommel. Preserve original blade-to-grip ratio and its restrained silver/brass/blue identity. No ornamental fantasy motifs or changes based on the name.
Create a professional coherent sheet showing the exact SAME dagger in FRONT, SIDE thickness, BACK, THREE-QUARTER, plus a small newly rendered HD inventory thumbnail. Whole item visible in every view, spacing clear. All geometry and materials agree; side shows thin plausible thickness. Rear and hidden cross-section are conservative inference, not an alternative design.
Realistic dark medieval steel, tarnished brass and worn navy leather with subtle wear. Plain opaque charcoal-gray background and neutral soft white studio light, no colored or dramatic light or hard painted shadows. Labels only GONNAGAL'S DIRK / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON. No character, hands, scenery, gems, skulls, glow, sci-fi, watermark or extra objects. Do not paste, trace, reproduce or display any pixel sprite anywhere; thumbnail must be a fresh detailed render of this same new concept.
entries.notes: Blade bevel, guard depth, wrap and rear details are inferred. All views inspected; geometric consistency is a modelling gate, not guaranteed by the image. New HD thumbnail is a concept preview, not a runtime icon.
